offset_reference: First nucleotide of the start codon is coordinate zero; offsets measure from the inclusive mapped threeprime read end.

reconstruction.profiles: Decode the first Plotly figure start-panel customdata binary arrays as raw counts. All 19 read-length rows from 22 to 40 nt are integral; no profile is inferred from normalized values.
reconstruction.read_totals: Recover bounded rational fractions from the two composition-bar traces, take their least common integer denominator (6,475,868), and multiply each fraction by it. These reconstructed relative counts reproduce all reported fractions to floating-point precision. The original absolute BAM accepted-read total is unverified up to a common integer multiplier; this does not affect coverage fractions or reference ranking.
reconstruction.scope: Only scored threeprime start profiles are retained. The report contains no raw fiveprime profiles; none are synthesized. Raw metagene counts are exact report values; read_totals and library_total are reconstructed relative counts, not a verified original BAM total or a fresh BAM rerun.
